Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [CS] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When one of your [CS] trait Digimon attacks, ＜Delay＞.
・Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
Security Effect: [Security] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
